name: role_shrine_maiden

emphasis: Miko shrine maiden. White haori jacket, red hakama pants, traditional hair accessories. Japanese shrine aesthetic.

name: anime_cel_shading
label: Cel Shading
emphasis: cel shading, hard shadow cutoffs, anime shading style, clean linework, 2D animation aesthetic

name: anime_chibi
label: Chibi
emphasis: chibi style, super deformed proportions, large head, small round body, cute exaggerated features, SD style

name: anime_cyberpunk
label: Cyberpunk
emphasis: cyberpunk anime, neon lights, futuristic setting, holographic elements, urban night, glowing accents

name: anime_dark
label: Dark Fantasy
emphasis: dark fantasy anime, deep shadows, dramatic contrast, gothic aesthetic, moody atmospheric illustration

name: anime_detailed
label: Detailed Illustration
emphasis: highly detailed anime illustration, intricate shading, rich vibrant colors, professional art quality, painterly

name: anime_flat_color
label: Flat Color
emphasis: flat_color, solid colors, bold outlines, minimal shading, clean lines, anime style illustration

name: anime_ghibli
label: Ghibli-Inspired
emphasis: Studio Ghibli inspired style, ghibli style, warm soft watercolor palette, painterly backgrounds, gentle character designs, natural lighting, hand-painted look, whimsical atmosphere

name: anime_moe
label: Moe
emphasis: moe anime style, soft rounded features, large expressive eyes, cute proportions, pastel color palette, warm gentle lighting, innocent sweet aesthetic, smooth clean lines, approachable character design

name: anime_retro
label: 90s Classic
emphasis: 1990s retro anime style, vintage cel animation aesthetic, classic anime art, film grain, aged look

name: anime_semi_realistic
label: Semi-Realistic
emphasis: semi-realistic anime style, realistic proportions and anatomy, detailed shading, painterly quality, grounded aesthetic, more lifelike than typical anime

name: anime_shonen
label: Shonen / Action
emphasis: shonen anime style, thick bold outlines, dynamic high-energy composition, dramatic contrast, strong confident linework, intense expressions, vivid saturated colors

name: anime_sketch
label: Sketch / Lineart
emphasis: pencil sketch, detailed lineart, anime sketch style, monochrome, clean lines, draft aesthetic

name: anime_soft_pastel
label: Soft Pastel
emphasis: soft pastel colors, gentle delicate linework, dreamy atmosphere, light airy tones, shoujo aesthetic

name: anime_watercolor
label: Watercolor
emphasis: watercolor anime illustration, soft edges, painted texture, flowing colors, artistic quality

name: dark_moody
label: Dark & Moody / Noir — deep shadows, contrast, graphic-novel feel
emphasis: Dark moody noir aesthetic. Deep crushed shadows, high contrast, rich dark tones. Describe the dramatic noir quality, heavy shadow areas with selective highlights, and graphic cinematic moodiness throughout.

name: hyperrealistic
label: Hyperrealistic — ultra-sharp, skin texture detail, pores visible
emphasis: Hyperrealistic photography. Extreme sharpness, visible skin texture and pores, fine hair detail, clinical precision. Describe microscopic skin detail, perfect focus, and ultra-realistic rendering as if 100MP medium format camera.

name: infrared
label: Infrared — surreal, glowing skin tones, dreamlike
emphasis: Infrared photography aesthetic. Skin glows luminous white, backgrounds shift surreal. Describe the ethereal dreamlike quality and unusual tonal rendering.

name: lomography
label: Lomography / Lo-Fi — light leaks, color shift, vignette
emphasis: Lomography lo-fi aesthetic. Visible light leaks, color aberration, strong vignette, shifted hues. Describe the analog imperfections, light bleeding at edges, and the raw spontaneous lo-fi photographic quality.

name: muted_tones
label: Muted / Desaturated — editorial faded palette, washed tones
emphasis: Desaturated editorial aesthetic. Muted, faded color palette, washed tones, low saturation. Describe the understated color grading, soft contrast, and high-fashion editorial quality.

name: soft_focus
label: Soft Focus / Dreamy — romantic blur, hazy glow, ethereal
emphasis: Soft focus dreamy aesthetic. Slight lens blur, glowing highlights, romantic haze. Describe the ethereal soft quality, dreamy out-of-focus edges, and warm glowing light diffusion throughout.

name: teal_orange
label: Teal & Orange — cinematic color grade, warm skin vs cool shadows
emphasis: Teal and orange cinematic color grade. Warm amber skin tones contrasted against cool teal-green shadows. Describe the Hollywood color grading with the striking warm-cool contrast throughout the image.

name: vintage_sepia
label: Vintage / Sepia — aged print, warm brown tones, nostalgic
emphasis: Vintage sepia photograph aesthetic. Warm brown-amber tones, aged print texture, slight fading at edges. Describe the nostalgic aged quality, warm monochromatic sepia palette, and antique photographic feel.
